description: This Scala source file defines the HiveSerDe class and object, providing mappings and utility functions for Hive serialization/deserialization formats within Apache Spark SQL, including methods to map data source strings to HiveSerDe objects and vice versa, as well as retrieving default storage configurations.

classes.name: HiveSerDe
classes.description: A case class representing Hive serialization/deserialization formats with optional inputFormat, outputFormat, and serde strings.

methods.name: sourceToSerDe
methods.description: Maps a data source string or class name to a HiveSerDe object, handling various Spark SQL data source class prefixes and file types.

methods.name: serdeToSource
methods.description: Retrieves the Spark data source name associated with a given HiveSerDe object.

methods.name: getDefaultStorage
methods.description: Determines the default storage format for Hive tables based on Spark configuration and hive-site.xml settings.
